description.html: Hanging artificial leaves are a vine with large, oval dark green leaves with light, almost white patterns, resembling popular houseplants from tropical forests. The vine hangs from the walls, mesh or branches of the terrarium and trails down the wall, so in a few minutes an empty terrarium takes on a jungle look.

The dense foliage creates shady spots and cover where animals feel safer, and gives them more options for climbing and hiding in the upper part of the terrarium. It suits tropical terrariums for crested geckos, frogs and other species that live among plants. Unlike live plants, it does not wilt and needs neither light nor watering.

Before setting it up, rinse the leaves in lukewarm water. Secure the vine so it does not hang directly above a heater or bulb, because artificial material should not be exposed to strong heat. In humid terrariums, take it down and wash it from time to time, as dust, food scraps and limescale from misting build up on the leaves. Branches and decorative roots from our supplies go well with it.
